decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Details of the kerb line alteration of the egress onto the A4 shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved works shall then be carried out before 1 December 2008 or the occupation of Building B (the hotel) as that building was approved under planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8 December 2006, whichever is the earlier.
description: Following approval for retention, alteration and extension of International House (7507m2 gross external floorspace) and its use as shops (A1 use class), restaurants (A3 use class) and B1A (office use) floorspace (as compared to planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8 December 2006, overall reduction of 1047sqm gross external area but increase of 79sqm gross internal area, details submitted pursuant to condition 26 (access points (details and implementation)) of permission reference 00505/P/P69 dated 19/03/08.
